issue.title: test_startup_update_toast_png_snapshot times out on notifications under visual-check load
issue.description:
## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_update_toast.py::test_startup_update_toast_png_snapshot`
- **Repro:** `just fix-tui-screenshots --check`

Proposed by sase-17d.12.2 notes #7 and #8 (2026-09-25). Under a 3-worker visual check (load1 about 30-40) the node timed out in wait_for notifications at 5s. The same node passed in isolation in 4.84s on the dirty tree. Fail rate from that report: 1 loaded failure, then a pass in isolation. This is the same node as sase-144, which tracks a footer SVC chip hash mismatch, not this wait timeout. The deck diff does not touch the update-toast fixture. The land agent did not re-run the visual suite.
